disposition: Go for the second isolated Windows primitive CI observation. No Windows replacement success or production support is established by this review.
limits: Code87 is consistent with the buffer defect but does not prove it is the sole cause.
No null-root/path-based fallback or automatic alternate API success was introduced.
No reviewer native probe, pytest, provider/model call, CI dispatch or production edit.
Native primitive success would still not establish concurrent reader atomicity, process crash/power-loss recovery, arbitrary ACL preservation or a production Windows effects backend.

primary_sources.supports: The rename buffer minimum includes sizeof structure plus name bytes; flags1/2 and relative simple name with RootDirectory are documented.
Flags apply to FileRenameInfoEx; FileNameLength is byte count and a directory handle may resolve a relative FileName.
Buffer length is in bytes and failed calls report GetLastError; a failure alone does not identify its specific invalid parameter.

reviewed_fix: The reviewed x64 ABI has FileName offset 20 and sizeof structure 24. The previous allocation offset+name_bytes+2 was two bytes below the documented native rename buffer minimum sizeof+name_bytes.
The changed allocation uses sizeof(FILE_RENAME_INFO)+UTF16 name byte count. The exact API, class22, flags3, non-null retained RootDirectory and relative single target leaf remain unchanged.
Pre-call rename_request records structure size, field offset, name length, allocation length, flags and parent-handle presence even if the API refuses.
Executed source hashes remain distinct from explicitly LF-normalized fingerprints; GITHUB_SHA and executable identity retained. Workflow bytes unchanged.
Both initial failure receipts remain byte-identical; results documentation treats the sizing correction as a hypothesis awaiting the second native result.
